note: Executable stable common projection. The source and target p2p-probe.sh scripts each run this repository's own Jest suite inside their checkout and map every observation below, keyed by observation id, to the raw result of that execution: test-backed observations resolve from the executed Jest report (per file / per named case), and the remaining observations resolve from process status, structural package.json shape, and declared-surface existence. No surface is expressed with a runner-specific prefix, so every observation is projected by this batch's executable probe on both sides. Both sides must resolve every observation to this same normalized value, and neither side uses a single-side status-only wrapper.
